title: ANVIL and Canadian sovereign defence technology peers for private review

selectedGap.reason: The operator explicitly scoped this run to increase reviewable Canadian company coverage while preserving evidence and duplicate controls.

guardrailNotes: All ten company candidates are private review records only and no published organization, capability, source, evidence, taxonomy, mission match, or relationship table is changed by this batch.

ANVIL is deliberately the first candidate; peer discovery covers sovereign defence AI, intelligence fusion, mission software, secure compute, ISR data assurance, geospatial analytics, C4ISR, and simulation while keeping derived mission relevance separate from public facts.

candidates.reviewerRationale: ANVIL is the operator-mandated first candidate and is recommended for green review. Four durable official sources resolve its legal identity, exact Ottawa contact, Canadian sovereignty posture, concrete platform architecture, defence use cases, and current government-facing activity. Its fit is direct: the platform sits at the intersection of mission data, intelligence fusion, AI-assisted planning, interoperability, and tactical-edge workflows. The reviewer should preserve attribution for company performance and interoperability claims while retaining the strong source-backed identity and capability record.
